verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an official API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, but the evidence is only a title and URL, with nothing showing it is interactive or has runnable examples. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the common guessed paths, which is a minor negative and not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it functionality, runnable code examples, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
